## Summary

I added a `currency` setting to the `Config` class with a default value of `"USD"`. Since the existing `load()` function dynamically discovers Config fields using `fields(Config)` and only applies those present in the TOML file, no other changes were needed. The setting is automatically configurable via `ledger.toml` entries like `currency = "EUR"`, following the same pattern as the existing settings. All tests pass.
